title: CMCC Global Opens Two Tokenized Fund Offerings on Bitfinex Securities
why_it_matters: The offerings put multi-manager digital-asset strategies into regulated token form, adding issuance, distribution and secondary-market infrastructure beyond tokenized stocks and cash-like funds.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONS

CMCC Global Opens Two Tokenized Fund Offerings on Bitfinex Securities

CMCC Global has opened subscriptions for tokenized interests in its Crest and Liberty Bitcoin Accumulation funds through Bitfinex Securities in El Salvador.
